description: Structured eval definitions for the QLDB Ledger Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across QLDB topologies (standard ledger with STANDARD permissions mode and deletion protection, cryptographic verification via digest + proof hash chain, stream to Kinesis for real-time CDC, journal export to S3 for compliance audit, ALLOW_ALL permissions mode prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production QLDB ledger with STANDARD permissions mode, deletion protection, and hash chain verification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — STANDARD permissions mode, deletion protection enabled, KMS customer-managed key, tables and indexes defined, hash chain verification workflow documented
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QLDB ledger named audit-ledger in us-east-1. Permissions mode STANDARD. Enable deletion protection. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abc123. Tables: transactions, accounts, audit_log. Indexes on transactions(transactionId, fromAccount) and accounts(accountId). Tags: Environment=production, Application=audit, Compliance=SOX.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QLDB_LEDGER: audit-ledger
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Ledger name: audit-ledger
  [✓] Permissions mode: STANDARD
  [✓] Deletion protection: enabled
  [✓] KMS encryption: customer-managed
  [✓] Tables: transactions, accounts, audit_log
  [✓] Indexes: transactions(transactionId, fromAccount), accounts(accountId)
  [✓] Cryptographic verification: digest + proof workflow documented
  [✓] Revision hash chain: SHA-256 chained blocks
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws qldb describe-ledger --name audit-ledger --region us-east-1
  aws qldb get-digest --name audit-ledger --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: QLDB ledger with cryptographic digest and proof verification workflow
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — digest + proof hash chain verification workflow documented, STANDARD permissions, deletion protection
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QLDB ledger named compliance-ledger in us-east-1 for regulatory compliance with cryptographic verification. Permissions mode STANDARD. Deletion protection enabled. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/verify123. I need the full digest and proof verification workflow documented. Tables: compliance_records. Indexes on compliance_records(recordId). Tags: Environment=production, Compliance=HIPAA.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QLDB_LEDGER: compliance-ledger
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Permissions mode: STANDARD
  [✓] Deletion protection: enabled
  [✓] Cryptographic verification: digest + proof workflow documented
  [✓] Revision hash chain: SHA-256 chained blocks
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws qldb get-digest --name compliance-ledger --region us-east-1
  aws qldb get-revision --name compliance-ledger ...

eval_cases.name: QLDB ledger with Kinesis Data Streams for real-time CDC
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Kinesis stream configured, IAM role for QLDB to write to Kinesis, stream started with inclusive start time
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QLDB ledger named realtime-events in us-east-1 with streaming to Kinesis for real-time CDC. Permissions mode STANDARD. Deletion protection. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/stream456. Kinesis stream qldb-events-stream. IAM role QLDBStreamRole. Stream start time 2026-08-05T00:00:00Z. Tags: Environment=production, Pipeline=CDC.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QLDB_LEDGER: realtime-events
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Permissions mode: STANDARD
  [✓] Stream to Kinesis: configured (stream: qldb-events-stream)
  [✓] IAM role: QLDBStreamRole
  [✓] Stream start time: 2026-08-05T00:00:00Z
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws qldb describe-ledger --name realtime-events --region us-east-1
  aws qldb list-journal-kinesis-streams-for-ledger --ledger-name realtime-events --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: QLDB ledger with journal export to S3 for compliance audit
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — S3 bucket configured, IAM role for QLDB to write to S3, export time range documented
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QLDB ledger named regulatory-ledger in us-east-1 with journal export to S3 for compliance audit. Permissions mode STANDARD. Deletion protection. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/export789. S3 bucket qldb-regulatory-export. IAM role QLDBExportRole. Export time range 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31. Tags: Environment=production, Compliance=GDPR.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QLDB_LEDGER: regulatory-ledger
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Permissions mode: STANDARD
  [✓] Journal export to S3: configured (bucket: qldb-regulatory-export)
  [✓] IAM role: QLDBExportRole
  [✓] Export time range: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws qldb describe-ledger --name regulatory-ledger --region us-east-1
  aws qldb list-journal-s3-exports-for-ledger --name regulatory-ledger --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: QLDB ledger with ALLOW_ALL permissions mode and no deletion protection (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — ALLOW_ALL permissions mode grants full CRUD to all principals; no deletion protection risks catastrophic data loss; should use STANDARD with deletion protection for production
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QLDB ledger named prod-ledger in us-east-1. Permissions mode ALLOW_ALL. No deletion protection. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abc123. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QLDB_LEDGER: prod-ledger
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Permissions mode: ALLOW_ALL — grants full CRUD to all principals; use STANDARD for production
  [✗] Deletion protection: disabled — production ledgers MUST have deletion protection enabled
